items.verbatim: THE DEVELOPMENT OF A FLEXIBLE CARBON FIBER PENETRATING NERVE CUFF AND CORTICAL ARRAY FOR NEURAL RECORDING, STIMULATION, AND NEUROCHEMICAL DETECTION - PENETRATING ELECTRODES FOR ELECTROPHYSIOLOGY RECORDING AND STIMULATION ARE CRITICAL TO UNDERSTANDING NEUROLOGICAL DISORDERS AND MENTAL HEALTH CONDITIO

items.industry: 医薬・ライフサイエンス
items.summary: Spike Neuro LLC(ミシガン州)がNIHのSTTR助成($990,107)を受け、Duke大学と共同で神経科学実験用の低電力ハイブリッド無線周波数システム(無線記録・電気刺激ヘッドステージ)を開発するフェーズI事業。
items.infer: 小型無線医療計測機器の試作研究であり、量産段階に進めば精密実装・小型電子部品組立装置の需要につながる可能性(推論)。
items.verbatim: ADDRESSING THE WIRELESS POWER PROBLEM: A LOW-POWER HYBRID RADIO FOR NEUROSCIENCE EXPERIMENTS - PROJECT SUMMARY CLOSED-LOOP STIMULATION IS KEY TO THE STUDY AND TREATMENT OF NEUROLOGICAL DISORDERS. HOWEVER, LARGELY DUE TO CURRENT WIRELESS POWER DEMANDS, STIMULATION SYSTEMS ARE RESTRICTED TO WIRED CONN
